messages:
tess: starting a concise gated rollout proposal for rwd-v6-lite-int4. goal: catch subtle quality regressions after quant + tokenizer tweak. short plan: preflight smoke -> micro-shadow -> 1% -> 7% -> 25%. posting gate rules draft.

omar: thanks. small nit: require two signal concurrence on the 1% step to avoid noise-triggered rollbacks. also suggest min_sample_per_slice of 3k and global min_samples_per_step 2k.

mira: add longform and rerank slices. longform traffic is sparse; require a longer eval window and higher min samples. recommend longform eval_window 40m, min_samples 5k. rerank needs MRR and RERANK_PCT delta checks.

tess: agreed. I'll include bespoke thresholds: warning at MRR_drop 0.5% (notify only), hard rollback at 1.6% for main MRR. hallucination: warn at +0.2pp, rollback at +0.5pp. latency: p95 rollback at +40ms. add tokens/sec drop rollback at 18% (since tokenizer change).

omar: can we make the warnings post to #canary-eyeballs and SRE to #sre-watch for hard failures? also require stabilization window of 8m for regular steps, 40m for longform.

mira: add min_sample check per slice and an overall sample_floor so we don't react to tiny K zeros. will also include an opt-in "require_concurrent_for_small_steps" flag for 1% step.

tess: draft console-ready snippet below (for ingestion). this thread will hold preflight smoke outputs and any quick notes.

```
rollout_id: 1781112223-gate
model: rwd-v6-lite-int4
stages:
  - preflight_smoke:
      enabled: true
      queries: 1200
      slices: [core, rerank, longform]
      duration: 00:20:00
  - micro_shadow: 00:30:00
  - canary_steps:
      - percent: 1
        duration: 00:10:00
        require_concurrent_failures: true
      - percent: 7
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 25
        duration: 01:00:00
auto_fallback:
  warnings:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 0.5
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      threshold_pp: 0.2
  hard_fail:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 1.6
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      threshold_pp: 0.5
    - metric: LATENCY_P95
      comparator: absolute_increase_ms
      threshold_ms: 40
    - metric: TOKENS_PER_SEC
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 18
slices:
  - name: core
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 10m
  - name: rerank
    metrics: [MRR, RERANK_PCT]
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 15m
  - name: longform
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 40m
general:
  min_samples_per_step: 2000
  require_concurrent_for_small_steps: true
  step_stability_window: 8m
  longform_stability_window: 40m
  preflight_smoke_queries: 1200
```

deploy-bot: rollout 1781112223-gate drafted in staging. manual start at /console/rollouts/1781112223-gate. runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/gate-rollout.

sre-oncall: adding ops watch for 3h. I'll monitor nodes for preempt/ooms and queue depth. escalate if queue depth > 450 or tokens/sec sustained drop > 12% for >5m.

tess: next steps: mira export slice defs & min-sample enforcement (ETA 25m), omar hook up webhooks to #canary-eyeballs and #sre-watch (ETA 15m), tess to run preflight smoke and post results (ETA 45m). will abort process and auto-rollback on any hard_fail breach with postmortem.
